How traditional book clubs inspired The Game Club to help gamers forge friendships as adults

In 2025, Guy Blomberg and Shay Leighton founded The Game Club, a community network inspired by traditional book clubs. Members play the same game each month and meet in small groups to discuss their experiences.

The launch is not the end: How Beholder: Conductor equalled its launch sales 15 months after release

Once a game is out, its post-release story can seem almost settled. After the launch window, a DLC or major patch might give players a reason to return – but if the team has no plans to keep working on the game, what is left to do except watch the sales taper off?

AppMagic: Non-gaming apps have beaten mobile games in IAP revenue since 2016

Mobile games last led in-app purchase (IAP) revenue in 2016, having since been outperformed by non-gaming platforms such as TikTok and AI chatbots.

Remedy Q3 revenue triples to €39.6m following launch of Control Resonant
